The settlement industry is navigating rapid change. Title companies, escrow agents, and closing professionals are operating in a market that's moving faster than the tools built to serve it. Marketing's role in capturing this moment isn't to run more campaigns. It's to read a complex, multi-vertical B2B funnel and make smart, fast decisions about what's working, who the real ideal customer is, and where to invest next. This is the role that owns that intelligence layer and growth strategies for the settlement segment.

The Role

As Senior Manager, Revenue Marketing — Settlement & Strategic Verticals, you own channel intelligence and judgment for Snapdocs' settlement marketing motion. The funnel here is more complex than the lender segment, and it's getting even more complex. Title companies, escrow agents, and independent closing professionals are the current base. But our notary and signing products can serve adjacent verticals: thousands of potential accounts across industries that haven't been mapped yet. This role requires someone who can hold multiple audience signals at once, help figure out who to target, how and where as new verticals open, and close the loop back to the Settlement PMM with clear, actionable direction. This is a campaign execution seat so your hands are on the wheel. And, you’ll create the strategies for leveraging both AI and marketing automation to help you handle execution. You're also the judgment layer that tells the business what's working, what to stop, and what to try next.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the channel intelligence layer for the settlement segment, across the current base (title companies, escrow agents, independent closing professionals) and the new verticals Snapdocs is expanding into

  • Define the ideal customer profile for each new vertical as it opens: who converts, who churns, what a good account looks like. You'll build this with data, since there's no playbook to inherit

  • Build the programs & campaigns, then read and interpret the performance signals across a multi-audience, high-volume B2B funnel — surfacing the distinctions between ICPs and building the next set of strategies to act on them

  • Close the loop back to the Settlement PMM on a defined cadence: You work in partnership with the PMM to feed insights, interpretations and recommendations back into the positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence and sales enablement that position Snapdocs to win.

  • Propose and own the attribution approach for a multi-vertical funnel. Get buy-in from sales and finance, and defend it when the numbers get questioned

  • Set KPIs for the marketing motion across all audience layers and own pipeline contribution reporting

  • Maintain the quality and accuracy bar on AI-generated content and channel outputs before they reach the market

  • Partner with Settlement Sales and Customer Success to understand where marketing signal connects to deal stage, expansion opportunity, or churn risk

  • Help build brand recognition in each new vertical from the ground up. As settlement expands past its current footprint, you help define what the brand needs to be

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years in B2B marketing, growth marketing, revenue marketing, or demand generation, with experience across multi-audience or multi-vertical funnels

  • Comfort with ambiguity and greenfield problems. New verticals don't come with a complete playbook, and you're energized by building one rather than waiting for it

  • Analyst-strategist orientation: you form clear hypotheses from messy data, make a channel or budget call, and can defend it under scrutiny

  • Direct experience designing an attribution model (not just operating one someone else built) and getting cross-functional buy-in on it

  • Experience working in genuine partnership with sales and customer success, not just parallel to them

  • AI-native working style: actively uses AI tools in daily work and exercises judgment about where outputs need human editorial intervention

  • Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms; HubSpot experience required

  • Proptech, real estate, title/settlement, fintech, healthcare, or similarly complex B2B vertical experience is a plus

  • Experience building brand recognition in a new market or vertical is a plus

Knowledge / Skills

  • Multi-Audience Signal Reading: You hold multiple funnel layers across a growing set of B2B verticals — title companies, escrow agents, independent closing professionals, and whatever comes next as settlement expands. You interpret each without and translate the distinctions into specific growth strategies and activities. .

  • Commercial Acuity: You think in pipeline and outcomes, not impressions and content volume. You design and defend attribution models yourself, rather than just operating one. You map signal to revenue stages across account types and bring that language naturally into your partnerships with the PMM, Sales, and CS teams.

  • Vertical & ICP Definition: As settlement expands, you help identify who the ideal customer actually is, using data. You define what a good account looks like before the playbook exists.

  • Systems Fluency: You understand how data architecture and measurement design enable or constrain interpretation. You work design the instrumentation a complex, multi-vertical funnel requires.

  • AI Pragmatism: You use AI tools to accelerate signal analysis, content iteration, and competitive monitoring, and you exercise judgment about when AI-generated content is off-brand, inaccurate, or simply not worth publishing before it reaches the market.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in being upfront about pay. The base salary range for this role is determined by your work location and falls into one of our geographic compensation zones:

  • Zone 1 (SF Bay Area, Seattle Metro, NYC): $165,000 - $183,000

  • Zone 2 (All other U.S. locations): $145,000 – $160,000

Where you land within the range depends on your experience, skills, and how you’ll make an impact in the role. In addition to base salary, this position includes meaningful equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Snapdocs

We’re here to transform one of the most critical and complex industries in the world. That requires a team that is curious, driven, thoughtful, and practical. We value:

  • Product discipline and clear reasoning

  • Deep ownership of outcomes (not just tasks)

  • Straightforward, honest communication

  • Empathy for the people who use our software

This is a place for people who want to solve hard, meaningful problems with real economic impact — not just ship features.

Join Us

We’re expanding our product suite and the network it connects. To do that, we need people who are excited by complexity, energized by scale, and motivated to make a tangible dent in how the mortgage ecosystem works. If you’re hungry to learn, build, and lead — you’ll do the best work of your career here.

To support our team, we offer a comprehensive & thoughtful benefits package for all full-time employees, which includes:

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with up to 4% company match

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Flexible Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 Sick Days for exempt roles

  • Generous Accrued Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 sick days for non-exempt roles

  • Summer & Winter Break (~1-week each) + 9 Holidays per year

  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

  • HSA Employer Contribution ($75-150 for individuals, $150-$250 for families)

  • $15K Family Building Benefit (lifetime limit)

  • Life and Disability Insurance

  • $1,500 Annual Lifestyle Stipend to support your well-being

Please note: Part-time employees are not eligible for benefits at this time

Snapdocs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Snapdocs needs a Controller who owns accounting as a function, not just as a close process. We want someone who can bring independent CPA-level judgment, keep the core operation tight, and change how the work gets done over time.

The role

This person leads accounting end to end. That includes technical accounting, close, audit readiness, tax coordination, controls, team leadership, prioritization, and the operating decisions that shape how accounting supports the business. It also includes setting a clear vision for how the function should evolve into a sharper, more modern accounting organization over time.

What you'll own

  • Own the accounting function end to end, including close, audit readiness, technical accounting, compliance with GAAP, and core reporting operations.

  • Lead and develop the accounting team, with day-one management responsibility for 2 direct reports and oversight across the broader team structure.

  • Build a clear view of where accounting needs to go over the next 12 months, then turn that view into a practical roadmap.

  • Shorten close timelines, reduce manual work, and improve how accounting systems and processes run across the function.

  • Partner with Product, Revenue, Customer Success, and Finance earlier in decision-making so accounting shapes the work instead of reacting late to it.

  • Guide accounting decisions tied to new products, pricing or packaging changes, contract structure, and other business changes with real technical judgment.

  • Evaluate how the team is structured today and what the team is prioritizing, then make changes when a different operating model, sequencing, or resourcing approach would better support the company.

What success looks like

  • Within 90 days, you've built trust with the team, gained an understanding of the day-to-day operation, and produced a clear roadmap for how accounting should evolve over time.

  • Within 6 months, the plan is in motion, the team is operating with better structure, and key processes are moving faster without quality slipping.

  • Within 12 months, accounting runs materially differently than it does today: faster close, stronger cross-functional partnership, and more capacity for higher-value work.

What we're looking for

  • CPA required.

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including meaningful time owning the controller seat or operating at a near-controller level.

  • Strong command of technical accounting, GAAP, audit management, and accounting controls.

  • Experience running an audit and close process with real ownership, not as one part of a heavily layered organization.

  • Track record of improving accounting operations in a lean environment where judgment and execution both matter.

  • Experience leading teams through process change, systems change, or organizational redesign.

  • Comfort making recommendations and decisions independently, with clear reasoning behind the call.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to insert accounting early, influence upstream decisions, and build credibility across the business.

  • Experience in SaaS or other recurring-revenue environments is useful. Experience in transaction-based or operationally messy models is even better.

  • Hands-on experience with modern accounting tools is preferred. Experience with Rillet, Tabs, or similarly modern accounting systems will stand out.

AI proficiency at Snapdocs

AI proficiency is a real requirement at Snapdocs. For this role, that means using AI to change how the work gets done: shortening close, reducing manual review, improving decision-making, and building repeatable workflows with appropriate checks.

You should be able to point to real examples of how you've used AI in accounting operations, where it worked, where it didn't, and how you validated outputs before they affected the books.

Compensation and benefits

We believe in being upfront about pay. The base salary range for this role is determined by your work location and falls into one of our geographic compensation zones:

  • Zone 1 (SF Bay Area, Seattle Metro, NYC): $168,000 - $210,000

  • Zone 2 (All other U.S. locations): $147,000 - $184,000

Where you land within the range depends on your experience, skills, and how you’ll make an impact in the role. In addition to base salary, this position includes meaningful equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Snapdocs

We’re here to transform one of the most critical and complex industries in the world. That requires a team that is curious, driven, thoughtful, and practical. We value:

  • Product discipline and clear reasoning

  • Deep ownership of outcomes (not just tasks)

  • Straightforward, honest communication

  • Empathy for the people who use our software

This is a place for people who want to solve hard, meaningful problems with real economic impact — not just ship features.

Join Us

We’re expanding our product suite and the network it connects. To do that, we need people who are excited by complexity, energized by scale, and motivated to make a tangible dent in how the mortgage ecosystem works. If you’re hungry to learn, build, and lead — you’ll do the best work of your career here.

To support our team, we offer a comprehensive & thoughtful benefits package for all full-time employees, which includes:

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with up to 4% company match

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Flexible Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 Sick Days for exempt roles

  • Generous Accrued Paid Vacation Time Off + 10 sick days for non-exempt roles

  • Summer & Winter Break (~1-week each) + 9 Holidays per year

  • Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

  • HSA Employer Contribution ($75-150 for individuals, $150-$250 for families)

  • $15K Family Building Benefit (lifetime limit)

  • Life and Disability Insurance

  • $1,500 Annual Lifestyle Stipend to support your well-being

Please note: Part-time employees are not eligible for benefits at this time

Snapdocs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
